The Atlas private endpoint docs describe an AWS interface endpoint in the customer's VPC. AWS pricing bills hourly per endpoint per Availability Zone plus per-GB data processed, so the cost advice follows. The original cited Atlas page alone did not support the AWS-specific parts, but the AWS pages do.
